info.name: HRMS API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for HRMS (Human Resource Management System) backend API with 91 endpoints across 11 modules, complete with Bearer token authentication, environment variables, realistic request bodies, and auto-token extraction scripts.

request.description: Returns greeting message confirming that the API service is alive.
Creates initial superadmin user. Can only be invoked when zero users exist in the database.
Authenticates with username & password. Automatically saves accessToken and refreshToken to collection variables.
Issues a new JWT access token and refreshes rotation using an active refresh token.
Revokes the active refresh token session.
Registers a login account for an employee and assigns a system role (requires EMPLOYEE_CREATE permission).
Creates a new department record (requires DEPARTMENT_CREATE permission).
Retrieves list of all departments (requires DEPARTMENT_VIEW permission).
Retrieves department details by UUID (requires DEPARTMENT_VIEW permission).
Updates an existing department (requires DEPARTMENT_UPDATE permission).
Creates a new job title / designation (requires DESIGNATION_CREATE permission).
Retrieves list of all designations (requires DESIGNATION_VIEW permission).
Retrieves single designation details by UUID (requires DESIGNATION_VIEW permission).
Updates designation name, code, or active status (requires DESIGNATION_UPDATE permission).
Registers a new employee (requires EMPLOYEE_CREATE permission).

query.description: Search query for name, code, or email
Filter by status: ACTIVE or INACTIVE

request.description: Lists all employees with search and pagination (requires EMPLOYEE_VIEW permission).
Retrieves complete employee record (requires EMPLOYEE_VIEW & access guard).
Updates employee personal/organizational details (requires EMPLOYEE_UPDATE permission).
Toggles employee lifecycle status between ACTIVE and INACTIVE (requires EMPLOYEE_STATUS_UPDATE permission).
Creates extended personal and contact details for an employee (requires EMPLOYEE_PROFILE_CREATE).
Retrieves extended profile details (requires EMPLOYEE_PROFILE_VIEW).
Modifies extended profile details (requires EMPLOYEE_PROFILE_UPDATE).
Creates government identity records: 12-digit Aadhaar & 10-char PAN (requires EMPLOYEE_IDENTITY_CREATE).
Fetches employee identity information (requires EMPLOYEE_IDENTITY_VIEW).
Updates employee Aadhaar and/or PAN details (requires EMPLOYEE_IDENTITY_UPDATE).
Creates bank account and IFSC details for payroll processing (requires EMPLOYEE_BANK_CREATE).
Retrieves bank details for an employee (requires EMPLOYEE_BANK_VIEW).
Updates employee banking information (requires EMPLOYEE_BANK_UPDATE).

Registers document record metadata directly (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_CREATE). Document types: AADHAAR, PAN, PASSPORT, RESUME, OFFER_LETTER, JOINING_LETTER, EXPERIENCE_LETTER, EDUCATIONAL_CERTIFICATE, OTHER.

formdata.description: AADHAAR | PAN | PASSPORT | RESUME | OFFER_LETTER | JOINING_LETTER | EXPERIENCE_LETTER | EDUCATIONAL_CERTIFICATE | OTHER

request.description: Uploads binary document file via multipart/form-data (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_UPLOAD).
Lists all uploaded document metadata records for an employee (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_VIEW).
Fetches single document record metadata (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_VIEW).
Streams and downloads the physical document file (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_DOWNLOAD).
Deletes document record and removes file from disk storage (requires EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_DELETE).
Directly creates an attendance record (requires ATTENDANCE_CREATE). Status options: PRESENT, ABSENT, HALF_DAY, LEAVE, HOLIDAY, WEEK_OFF.

query.description: PRESENT | ABSENT | HALF_DAY | LEAVE | HOLIDAY | WEEK_OFF

request.description: Lists attendance history for an employee (requires ATTENDANCE_VIEW).
Aggregates total days present, absent, half days, and leaves for the specified month (requires ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY_VIEW).
Records current timestamp check-in for today's work shift (requires ATTENDANCE_CHECK_IN).
Records current timestamp check-out and computes total working hours (requires ATTENDANCE_CHECK_OUT).
Fetches a specific attendance entry by UUID (requires ATTENDANCE_VIEW).
Modifies an existing attendance log entry (requires ATTENDANCE_UPDATE).
Deletes an attendance entry (requires ATTENDANCE_DELETE).
Submits a leave request (requires LEAVE_CREATE). Leave types: CASUAL, SICK, EARNED, UNPAID, MATERNITY, PATERNITY, OTHER.

query.description: CASUAL | SICK | EARNED | UNPAID | MATERNITY | PATERNITY | OTHER

request.description: Retrieves list of leave applications with filter parameters (requires LEAVE_VIEW).
Retrieves total days used and breakdown per leave type for a year (requires LEAVE_SUMMARY_VIEW).
Fetches details of a single leave application (requires LEAVE_VIEW).
Modifies pending leave dates or reason (requires LEAVE_UPDATE).
Cancels an applied leave request (requires LEAVE_DELETE).
Approves an employee's leave request (requires LEAVE_APPROVE and ScopeAccessGuard).
Rejects a leave request with an explicit rejection reason (requires LEAVE_REJECT and ScopeAccessGuard).
Allocates annual leave quota for an employee (requires LEAVE_BALANCE_CREATE).
Lists all leave balances and remaining quotas (requires LEAVE_BALANCE_VIEW).
Gets single leave balance allocation record (requires LEAVE_BALANCE_VIEW).
Defines a new performance review appraisal cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_CYCLE_CREATE).
Retrieves all performance appraisal cycles (requires PERFORMANCE_CYCLE_VIEW).
Fetches details of a performance cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_CYCLE_VIEW).
Updates cycle date ranges or transitions status: DRAFT, OPEN, CLOSED (requires PERFORMANCE_CYCLE_UPDATE).
Deletes a performance cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_CYCLE_DELETE).

request.description: Sets a weighted performance goal/KPI for an employee within a cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_GOAL_CREATE).
Lists all goals assigned to an employee for a cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_GOAL_VIEW).
Retrieves details of a single performance goal (requires PERFORMANCE_GOAL_VIEW).

  "weight": 40,
  "progress": 75,
  "status": "IN_PROGRESS",

request.description: Updates progress %, status (NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED), or target (requires PERFORMANCE_GOAL_UPDATE).
Deletes a goal from the cycle (requires PERFORMANCE_GOAL_DELETE).
Creates an evaluation review for a goal (requires PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION_CREATE). Types: SELF, MANAGER. Rating: 1 to 5.
Lists all evaluation entries (self and manager) on a goal (requires PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION_VIEW).
Retrieves a specific evaluation review by UUID (requires PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION_VIEW).
Updates rating or feedback comments before submission (requires PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION_UPDATE).
Locks and officially submits the evaluation (requires PERFORMANCE_EVALUATION_SUBMIT).
Computes weighted final score and closes appraisal summary (requires PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY_FINALIZE).
Retrieves aggregated cycle score, goal ratings, and final evaluation summary (requires PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY_VIEW).

Fetches policy content and details (requires POLICY_VIEW permission).

request.description: Updates policy text, version, or code (requires POLICY_UPDATE permission).
Deletes a policy entry (requires POLICY_DELETE permission).
Publishes policy, making it visible to all employees for mandatory acknowledgement (requires POLICY_PUBLISH permission).
Archives obsolete policy version (requires POLICY_ARCHIVE permission).
Marks that an employee has read and accepted the policy terms (requires POLICY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_CREATE).
Lists all policies acknowledged by an employee (requires POLICY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_VIEW).
Provides company-wide compliance list of employees who acknowledged a specific policy (requires POLICY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_POLICY_VIEW).
Checks whether a specific employee has acknowledged a given policy (requires POLICY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_STATUS_VIEW).
Creates draft expense reimbursement claim (requires REIMBURSEMENT_CREATE).

query.description: DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | PAID | CANCELLED

request.description: Lists employee reimbursement claims (requires REIMBURSEMENT_VIEW).
Retrieves details of single expense claim (requires REIMBURSEMENT_VIEW).
Updates expense details before submission (requires REIMBURSEMENT_UPDATE).
Deletes a draft reimbursement claim (requires REIMBURSEMENT_DELETE).
Transitions claim from DRAFT to SUBMITTED for manager approval (requires REIMBURSEMENT_SUBMIT).

formdata.description: Receipt invoice image or PDF file

request.description: Attaches bill/receipt proof to the expense claim via multipart file upload (requires REIMBURSEMENT_RECEIPT_UPLOAD).
Approves submitted reimbursement (requires REIMBURSEMENT_APPROVE and ScopeAccessGuard).
Rejects reimbursement claim with reason (requires REIMBURSEMENT_REJECT and ScopeAccessGuard).
Finance/Payroll action marking the approved reimbursement claim as settled/paid (requires REIMBURSEMENT_PAY).
Lists all available granular system permissions (requires PERMISSION_VIEW).
Gets single permission details by UUID (requires PERMISSION_VIEW).
Retrieves list of all configured user roles (requires ROLE_VIEW).
Fetches details of a specific role (requires ROLE_VIEW).
Creates a new custom role with optional initial permissions (requires ROLE_CREATE).
Updates role name, code, or description (requires ROLE_UPDATE).
Enables an inactive role (requires ROLE_ACTIVATE).
Deactivates a role, temporarily removing access for assigned users (requires ROLE_DEACTIVATE).
Overwrites role permissions with the provided list of permission UUIDs (requires ROLE_PERMISSION_ASSIGN).
Retrieves list of permissions assigned to this role (requires ROLE_VIEW).
